reference.comparisonScope: Acceptance and output, not exact exception messages. Intentional differences are not compatibility passes.

host.http: Actual loopback HTTP including chunked limits and concurrent requests; server closed

browser.scope: Actual desktop page interactions and layout; no mobile or cross-browser assertion

robustness.scope: Original entry only; not full fuzzing of new APIs

performance.scope: 3 warmups and 7 measured batches, median; same input strings and output equality; excludes JSON parsing/serialization and subprocess I/O. MoonBit returns exact decimal strings while Python cn2an returns numeric values; different runtimes and output contracts, no universal performance conclusion.

coverage: Not remeasured; historical instrumentation counts are not current feature coverage
remaining: Broader real corpus and complete upstream boundary/version review
Documented behavior differences and expanded dialect/region rules
